summary: This Phase 4 clinical trial compared two different drugs, inclisiran and bempedoic acid, to see how well they lower low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C), which is the harmful type of cholesterol in the blood. The study looked at adults with atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease, a condition where plaque builds up inside the arteries. Novartis Pharmaceuticals sponsored this research, which included 402 participants. The trial has been completed.
